summary: Tested PWA-optimized login flow features. All tests pass: /login page loads correctly on desktop with full marketing content, /home page loads with marketing content and navigation, login flow works with credentials, navigation between /home and /login works, Forgot Password modal renders correctly, no console errors.

Option C mobile browser install banner at line 1186 correctly shows only when isMobileBrowser() returns true
HomePage.js correctly implements centered marketing page with 'Get Started' and 'Sign In' hero buttons
App.js route /home at line 244 correctly resolves to HomePage component
PWAInstallGuide component has proper data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA login flow features are fully functional. Key points: (1) /login on desktop shows full marketing page with login card, flag background, nav bar, and scrollable sections (About, Features, Security, Steps). (2) /home is a new marketing landing page with centered content, 'Get Started' and 'Sign In' hero buttons. (3) PWA standalone mode (display-mode: standalone) shows simplified login view - cannot be tested in Playwright as browser is desktop. (4) Option C mobile browser install banner only shows on iOS/Android mobile browsers. (5) Login flow works correctly with 2FA support.
